items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I played it every Sunday from 5 to 9, Lou Donaldson and the Red Garland Trio.

ctx.x: “I bet you would do that.” I said, “Yeah, I would. I’m not gonna fight you fair!” [LAUGHS] But actually, it was so sad... But I’m not telling you anything you don’t know. And most people who are interested in jazz... One time I played down in Washington, in the park, sort of like a Jazzmobile. It was on a Saturday. It was from 5 to 8. So I’m playing, and at the end, it was still light and everything, and I said, “Man, let’s drive back through Baltimore and catch Miles,” because Miles was at a place called the…
